power.title: NASA POWER daily point (MERRA-2 cell), AG community

imerg.title: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation V07 (Final run; Late run after the last Final day), 0.1 deg

smap_l4.title: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture (SPL4SMGP v008), via AppEEARS

grace.title: NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO data-assimilation drought indicators (GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D v3.0), 0.25 deg weekly

notes: weeks start Monday; ndvi_* are over the Sentinel-2/Landsat observations in that week (null if none), p10/p90 are across observations not pixels
power_tmax_c/tmin_c weekly means, power_eto_mm weekly sum (Hargreaves)
usdm_category = highest category with >= 50% of the county in that category or worse (county 06107)

NASA columns: imerg_7d_mm (IMERG week total), smap_sm / smap_sm_pct (SMAP L4 root zone m3/m3 / percentile), grace_*_pct (GRACE-DA percentiles), modis_ndvi_anomaly (latest 16-day composite vs 2000-2025), esi (ECOSTRESS, clear scenes). Null = no observation that week or dataset not cached yet; nbr2, lst_anomaly_k and openet_et_mm_month are not filled.
